# The CMS's schema

`contentTypes.d.ts` and `components.d.ts` are `types/generated/contentTypes.d.ts` and
`types/generated/components.d.ts` of bogd3v/micelio-cms, copied byte for byte at the commit named in
`PIN`. Only `test/cmsPopulate.test.ts` reads them; no code of the app imports them. Never edit them by
hand. To move the pin, see "The populate check" in `docs/architecture/contract-tests.md`.
